READ.label: View Channels
READ.desc: Allows members to view channels and read their messages.

SEND.label: Send Messages
SEND.desc: Allows members to send messages in text channels.

REACT.label: Add Reactions
REACT.desc: Allows members to add new reactions to messages.

MANAGE_MESSAGES.label: Manage Messages
MANAGE_MESSAGES.desc: Allows members to delete messages by others and pin them.

ADMIN.label: Administrator
ADMIN.desc: Grants ALL permissions and bypasses channel overrides. Grant with extreme caution.

MANAGE_CHANNELS.label: Manage Channels
MANAGE_CHANNELS.desc: Allows members to create, edit, reorder and delete channels.

MANAGE_ROLES.label: Manage Roles
MANAGE_ROLES.desc: Allows members to create roles, edit those below their own, and assign them.

KICK_MEMBERS.label: Kick Members
KICK_MEMBERS.desc: Allows members to remove others from the server. They can rejoin with an invite.

BAN_MEMBERS.label: Ban Members
BAN_MEMBERS.desc: Allows members to permanently ban others from the server.

CONNECT.label: Connect
CONNECT.desc: Allows members to join voice channels.

SPEAK.label: Speak
SPEAK.desc: Allows members to talk in voice channels.

VIDEO.label: Video & Screen Share
VIDEO.desc: Allows members to turn on their camera and share their screen.

CREATE_INVITE.label: Create Invite
CREATE_INVITE.desc: Allows members to invite new people to the server.

MANAGE_SERVER.label: Manage Server
MANAGE_SERVER.desc: Allows members to change the server's name, icon, safety and AutoMod.

MENTION_EVERYONE.label: Mention @everyone, @here, and All Roles
MENTION_EVERYONE.desc: Allows members to notify everyone at once.

ATTACH_FILES.label: Attach Files
ATTACH_FILES.desc: Allows members to upload files and images.

CHANGE_NICKNAME.label: Change Nickname
CHANGE_NICKNAME.desc: Allows members to change their own nickname on this server.

MANAGE_NICKNAMES.label: Manage Nicknames
MANAGE_NICKNAMES.desc: Allows members to change other members' nicknames.

MUTE_MEMBERS.label: Mute Members
MUTE_MEMBERS.desc: Allows members to mute or deafen others in voice.

MOVE_MEMBERS.label: Move Members
MOVE_MEMBERS.desc: Allows members to move or disconnect others from voice channels.

VIEW_AUDIT_LOG.label: View Audit Log
VIEW_AUDIT_LOG.desc: Allows members to view the server's change history.

MANAGE_EMOJIS.label: Manage Emoji
MANAGE_EMOJIS.desc: Allows members to add and remove the server's custom emoji.

MANAGE_WEBHOOKS.label: Manage Webhooks
MANAGE_WEBHOOKS.desc: Allows members to create, edit and delete webhooks.

MANAGE_EVENTS.label: Manage Events
MANAGE_EVENTS.desc: Allows members to create, edit and cancel events.
